acceptanceCriteria.text: `runtime ensure --descriptor` consumes the descriptor's Route 4 provider profile required for the selected release rather than discarding it.
Supported Lima/QEMU/provider identities used to inspect or reconcile managed state are derived from or explicitly matched against the selected descriptor profile.
A descriptor whose supported Route 4 provider identity differs from the active/managed provider fails closed before Route 3 mutation.
Existing explicit adoption/provisioning state is accepted only when it proves the exact selected release profile; ambient PATH remains non-authoritative.
Compiled code retains only the compatibility/validation policy needed to interpret supported descriptor profiles and does not become a second release-identity authority.
Regression coverage proves that changing the descriptor provider identity changes or rejects the consumed Route 4 requirement instead of silently continuing with defaults.
The fix composes with #826's activated QEMU data-closure verification and does not reintroduce Mottainai-owned QEMU lifecycle/device topology.

issue.title: fix(runtime): consume the Route 4 provider profile from the deployment descriptor
